notes.title: Patch V1.5 released
notes.notes:
Patch note:
- Add more batteries to the game.
- Torch usage time increased.
- Add more hints on the game.
- Some minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Silence Channel Demo Version
notes.notes:
The demo version of the Silence Channel has been prepared and you can download it for free next week.  Your comments about this game will help us a lot, so please send us your comments.
You can follow us (@lexipgames)on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook for more information.
